The '''Avarik Armaments long rifle'''<ref name="TCWEG" /> was a model of [[Longblaster/Legends|longblaster]] produced by [[Avarik Armaments]]. The [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] offered significant stopping power even at long distances, but required an expert [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] behind the trigger. The [[Onderonian/Legends|Onderonian]] [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] owned an Avarik Armaments long rifle<ref name="TCWEG" /> and used it as [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] while leading the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] against the [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Onca/Legends|Onca]] carried a Avarik Armaments long rifle.<ref name="The Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref>
